commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+2' Raphinha (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' Raphinha (Barcelona) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
88' The corner from Pedri (Barcelona) is hurriedly cleared.

88' Pau Victor (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
87' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Pau Victor (Barcelona). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
86' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner kick, but Marko Dmitrovic reads it well and stops the effort.
84' Gavi (Barcelona) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
84' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
83' Diego Garcia (Leganes) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
82' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Seydouba Cisse and he is replaced by Dani Raba (Leganes).
80' Here comes a substitution. Pau Victor (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Marc Casado.

79' What a huge chance for Jules Kounde (Barcelona). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
79' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
77' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

71' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
69' A lofted cross from Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
67' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

66' It is time for a substitution. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is on for Dani Olmo.
66' Marcus Sorg prepares a substitution. Robert Lewandowski is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
65' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pedri (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
64' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:3.

52' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is free in the box and Dani Olmo finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!

49' Pedri (Barcelona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

45+4' A precise short pass from Lamine Yamal releases Dani Olmo (Barcelona) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.

43' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
41' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
39' A precise low pass is received by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
39' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
39' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and Barcelona manage to earn a corner.

36' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Marko Dmitrovic easily makes the save.
33' Raphinha (Barcelona) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.
31' Adria Altimira (Leganes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Quintero signals a set piece.
26' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
24' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
22' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
21' Jules Kounde looks up and sends over a pin-point cross to Dani Olmo (Barcelona) near the penalty spot, but he totally fluffs his lines and plants a tame header well wide of the right post.
19' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
16' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

12' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Barcelona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
10' A fine pass finds Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marko Dmitrovic reacts superbly to deny him.
9' Wonderful movement by Barcelona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
4' 0 - 1 Oscar Rodriguez takes the corner and Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the roof of the net. The score is 0:1.
3' There's an opportunity for Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

3' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Inaki Pena to get hold of the ball.
